title: MatchEvent
description: A single normalized match event. Raw provider data never crosses the simulator boundary.

id.description: Stable unique event id (used for de-duplication).

type.title: EventType
type.description: What happened. For own_goal, team and player are the side that put the ball into its own net; the goal counts for the opponent. goal_disallowed cancels a goal already in the feed (e.g. after a VAR review): team is the side whose goal it was, and disallowed_goal says which and why.

possession_id.description: Possession sequence number within the match.

outcome.title: EventOutcome
outcome.description: Success or failure for actions that have one (e.g. pass completion). Omitted otherwise.

type.title: ShotType
type.description: The situation the shot came from. Omitted if the provider does not say.

card.title: Card
card.description: A card shown to player with this event: on a foul_committed, or on other for misconduct away from a foul. second_yellow is a sending-off, like red.

penalty_awarded.description: On foul_committed or foul_won: the foul gave away a penalty. A provider may flag both events of the same foul.

disallowed_goal.title: DisallowedGoal
disallowed_goal.description: On goal_disallowed: the goal it cancels.

event_id.description: id of the shot or own_goal event of the goal.
